frameworks: IT general controls supporting internal control over financial reporting (COSO 2013 Principle 11; PCAOB AS 2201). NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 references are provided for cross-walking.

controls.objective: New user access is approved before it is granted.
controls.procedure: For every account created in the period, inspect evidence of an approved access request.

controls.objective: Access for terminated employees is removed promptly.
controls.procedure: Match HR terminations in the period to application accounts; confirm each was disabled within the allowed number of days and not used afterward.

controls.objective: User access is reviewed by management every quarter.
controls.procedure: Confirm a review was completed by its due date for every quarter in the period and that exceptions found were remediated.

controls.objective: Privileged access is restricted to appropriate personnel.
controls.procedure: Inspect all accounts with administrative privileges; confirm each belongs to an authorized department and is assigned to a named person.

controls.objective: Users do not hold incompatible duties.
controls.procedure: Compare each active user's roles against the segregation-of-duties rule set.

controls.objective: Shared and generic accounts are not used.
controls.procedure: Identify active accounts not assigned to an individual or an approved service.

controls.objective: Changes are approved before they are deployed to production.
controls.procedure: For every standard change deployed in the period, confirm an approval dated on or before deployment.
For every change deployed in the period, inspect evidence of testing.

controls.objective: Developers cannot deploy their own changes to production.
controls.procedure: Compare the developer and the person who deployed each change.

controls.objective: Approvers are independent of the developer.
controls.procedure: Compare the developer and the approver of each change.

controls.objective: Emergency changes are approved after the fact within the allowed time.
controls.procedure: For every emergency change, confirm retroactive approval within the allowed number of days.

controls.objective: Failed backup and batch jobs are followed up.
controls.procedure: For every failed job in the period, confirm a ticket documents investigation and resolution.
Confirm at least one successful restore test of the financial system during the period.
